method: Five fixed cross-lane mouth coordinates, with identical old/new input speeds and charge fixtures in identical world creation order. Synthetic earned charge is a local mechanism fixture, NOT natural earning. Invalid initial solids are retained and excluded from success interpretation. Inputs/bat keys unused, 20 second cap. Upstream .5 is descriptive, not an adoption threshold. Full trace sampled every .1 second. Actual-phone/human play untested.
